question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A place where fruit trees are grown
solution: The correct answer is **"Orchard."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • An **"orchard"** is a place where fruit trees are grown. (फलों का बाग़, फलोद्यान) • **Example**: *The farmer has an **orchard**__ with apple, pear, and peach trees. * • It is a noun and is pronounced as 'awr-chuhrd'. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Dyke**: A wall or embankment to prevent flooding. (निम्न भूमि पर पानी के बहाव को रोकने के लिए नदी अथवा समुद्र पर बनी एक लंबी, मोटी दीवार, बाँध, तटबंध) • **Example**: *The city built a **dyke**__ to protect the town from the river.* • **Botanical**: Relating to plants or the study of plants. (वनस्‍पति-शास्‍त्र संबंधित) __ • **Example**: *The **botanical**__ garden has a wide variety of exotic plants.* • **Cemetery**: A place where dead people are buried. (क़ब्रिस्‍तान, विशेषतः वह स्‍थान जो गिरजाघर की संपत्ति नहीं है) __ • **Example**: *We visited the **cemetery**__ to pay our respects to our ancestors. * 33:T8f2, The correct answer is **'No improvement.'**
